title_zh: Man’s best friends — 第12节可背诵讲义
body_en: A guide dog helps people walk safely. Farm dogs watch the land. Cats keep quiet friends at home. Before you get a pet, ask: do we have time every day? Read about animal needs in a short book or a class text. Love means work, not only cute photos.
body_zh: 导盲犬帮助人们安全行走。农场犬守着土地。猫在家里安静陪伴。养宠物前先问：我们每天有时间吗？读一本短书或课文了解动物需求。爱意味着付出，而不只是可爱照片。
